1	---
     2	name: frontend-design
     3	description: Expert frontend design guidelines for creating beautiful, modern UIs. Use when building landing pages, dashboards, or any user interface.
     4	metadata: {"clawdbot":{"emoji":"🎨"}}
     5	---
     6	
     7	# Frontend Design Skill
     8	
     9	Use this skill when creating UI components, landing pages, dashboards, or any frontend design work.
    10	
    11	## Design Workflow
    12	
    13	Follow this structured approach for UI design:
    14	
    15	1. **Layout Design** — Think through component structure, create ASCII wireframes
    16	2. **Theme Design** — Define colors, fonts, spacing, shadows
    17	3. **Animation Design** — Plan micro-interactions and transitions
    18	4. **Implementation** — Generate the actual code
    19	
    20	### 1. Layout Design
    21	
    22	Before coding, sketch the layout in ASCII format:
    23	
    24	```
    25	┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
    26	│         HEADER / NAV BAR            │
    27	├─────────────────────────────────────┤
    28	│                                     │
    29	│            HERO SECTION             │
    30	│         (Title + CTA)               │
    31	│                                     │
    32	├─────────────────────────────────────┤
    33	│   FEATURE   │  FEATURE  │  FEATURE  │
    34	│     CARD    │   CARD    │   CARD    │
    35	├─────────────────────────────────────┤
    36	│            FOOTER                   │
    37	└─────────────────────────────────────┘
    38	```
    39	
    40	### 2. Theme Guidelines
    41	
    42	**Color Rules:**
    43	- NEVER use generic bootstrap-style blue (#007bff) — it looks dated
    44	- Prefer oklch() for modern color definitions
    45	- Use semantic color variables (--primary, --secondary, --muted, etc.)
    46	- Consider both light and dark mode from the start
    47	
    48	**Font Selection (Google Fonts):**
    49	```
    50	Sans-serif: Inter, Roboto, Poppins, Montserrat, Outfit, Plus Jakarta Sans, DM Sans, Space Grotesk
    51	Monospace: JetBrains Mono, Fira Code, Source Code Pro, IBM Plex Mono, Space Mono, Geist Mono
    52	Serif: Merriweather, Playfair Display, Lora, Source Serif Pro, Libre Baskerville
    53	Display: Architects Daughter, Oxanium
    54	```
    55	
    56	**Spacing & Shadows:**
    57	- Use consistent spacing scale (0.25rem base)
    58	- Shadows should be subtle — avoid heavy drop shadows
    59	- Consider using oklch() for shadow colors too
    60	
    61	### 3. Theme Patterns
    62	
    63	**Modern Dark Mode (Vercel/Linear style):**
    64	```css
    65	:root {
    66	  --background: oklch(1 0 0);
    67	  --foreground: oklch(0.145 0 0);
    68	  --primary: oklch(0.205 0 0);
    69	  --primary-foreground: oklch(0.985 0 0);
    70	  --secondary: oklch(0.970 0 0);
    71	  --muted: oklch(0.970 0 0);
    72	  --muted-foreground: oklch(0.556 0 0);
    73	  --border: oklch(0.922 0 0);
    74	  --radius: 0.625rem;
    75	  --font-sans: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif;
    76	}
    77	```
    78	
    79	**Neo-Brutalism (90s web revival):**
    80	```css
    81	:root {
    82	  --background: oklch(1 0 0);
    83	  --foreground: oklch(0 0 0);
    84	  --primary: oklch(0.649 0.237 26.97);
    85	  --secondary: oklch(0.968 0.211 109.77);
    86	  --accent: oklch(0.564 0.241 260.82);
    87	  --border: oklch(0 0 0);
    88	  --radius: 0px;
    89	  --shadow: 4px 4px 0px 0px hsl(0 0% 0%);
    90	  --font-sans: DM Sans, sans-serif;
    91	  --font-mono: Space Mono, monospace;
    92	}
    93	```
    94	
    95	**Glassmorphism:**
    96	```css
    97	.glass {
    98	  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    99	  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
   100	  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
   101	  border-radius: 1rem;
   102	}
   103	```
   104	
   105	### 4. Animation Guidelines
   106	
   107	**Micro-syntax for planning:**
   108	```
   109	button: 150ms [S1→0.95→1] press
   110	hover: 200ms [Y0→-2, shadow↗]
   111	fadeIn: 400ms ease-out [Y+20→0, α0→1]
   112	slideIn: 350ms ease-out [X-100→0, α0→1]
   113	bounce: 600ms [S0.95→1.05→1]
   114	```
   115	
   116	**Common patterns:**
   117	- Entry animations: 300-500ms, ease-out
   118	- Hover states: 150-200ms
   119	- Button press: 100-150ms
   120	- Page transitions: 300-400ms
   121	
   122	### 5. Implementation Rules
   123	
   124	**Tailwind CSS:**
   125	```html
   126	<!-- Import via CDN for prototypes -->
   127	<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
   128	```
   129	
   130	**Flowbite (component library):**
   131	```html
   132	<link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/flowbite@2.0.0/dist/flowbite.min.css" rel="stylesheet">
   133	<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/flowbite@2.0.0/dist/flowbite.min.js"></script>
   134	```
   135	
   136	**Icons (Lucide):**
   137	```html
   138	<script src="https://unpkg.com/lucide@latest/dist/umd/lucide.min.js"></script>
   139	<script>lucide.createIcons();</script>
   140	```
   141	
   142	**Images:**
   143	- Use real placeholder services: Unsplash, placehold.co
   144	- Never make up image URLs
   145	- Example: `https://images.unsplash.com/photo-xxx?w=800&h=600`
   146	
   147	### 6. Responsive Design
   148	
   149	Always design mobile-first and responsive:
   150	
   151	```css
   152	/* Mobile first */
   153	.container { padding: 1rem; }
   154	
   155	/* Tablet */
   156	@media (min-width: 768px) {
   157	  .container { padding: 2rem; }
   158	}
   159	
   160	/* Desktop */
   161	@media (min-width: 1024px) {
   162	  .container { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; }
   163	}
   164	```
   165	
   166	### 7. Accessibility
   167	
   168	- Use semantic HTML (header, main, nav, section, article)
   169	- Include proper heading hierarchy (h1 → h2 → h3)
   170	- Add aria-labels to interactive elements
   171	- Ensure sufficient color contrast (4.5:1 minimum)
   172	- Support keyboard navigation
   173	
   174	### 8. Component Design Tips
   175	
   176	**Cards:**
   177	- Subtle shadows, not heavy drop shadows
   178	- Consistent padding (p-4 to p-6)
   179	- Hover state: slight lift + shadow increase
   180	
   181	**Buttons:**
   182	- Clear visual hierarchy (primary, secondary, ghost)
   183	- Adequate touch targets (min 44x44px)
   184	- Loading and disabled states
   185	
   186	**Forms:**
   187	- Clear labels above inputs
   188	- Visible focus states
   189	- Inline validation feedback
   190	- Adequate spacing between fields
   191	
   192	**Navigation:**
   193	- Sticky header for long pages
   194	- Clear active state indication
   195	- Mobile-friendly hamburger menu
   196	
   197	---
   198	
   199	## Quick Reference
   200	
   201	| Element | Recommendation |
   202	|---------|---------------|
   203	| Primary font | Inter, Outfit, DM Sans |
   204	| Code font | JetBrains Mono, Fira Code |
   205	| Border radius | 0.5rem - 1rem (modern), 0 (brutalist) |
   206	| Shadow | Subtle, 1-2 layers max |
   207	| Spacing | 4px base unit (0.25rem) |
   208	| Animation | 150-400ms, ease-out |
   209	| Colors | oklch() for modern, avoid generic blue |
   210	
   211	---
   212	
   213	*Based on SuperDesign patterns — https://superdesign.dev*

1	# MedBook — Find and Book Top Doctors Instantly
     2	
     3	## Brand
     4	MedBook is an online healthcare appointment marketplace that connects patients with local doctors, dentists, and specialists for easy same-day booking. The platform empowers patients to search by specialty, location, and insurance, read verified reviews, and book appointments online in minutes — all completely free for patients. The tone is modern, professional, and playful, making healthcare access feel simple and approachable.
     5	
     6	Brand colors: #1B1464 (primary navy), #FFD930 (accent yellow), #FFFFFF (background white)
     7	
     8	## Hero Content
     9	Title: Find and book the care you need
    10	Subtitle: Search thousands of doctors, dentists, and specialists. Read verified patient reviews. Book appointments instantly — even same-day. It's that easy, and always free.
    11	CTA: "Find a Doctor" | "Search"
    12	
    13	Search bar placeholder: Search by condition, specialty, or doctor name
    14	Location field placeholder: City, state, or zip code
    15	Insurance field placeholder: Choose your insurance plan
    16	
    17	## Search Bar
    18	The primary search interface includes three fields:
    19	- **Specialty / Condition / Doctor** — autocomplete text input with dropdown suggestions (e.g., "Dentist," "Back pain," "Dr. Sarah Chen")
    20	- **Location** — city, state, or zip code with geolocation auto-detect option
    21	- **Insurance** — dropdown selector with major insurance carriers (Aetna, Blue Cross, Cigna, UnitedHealthcare, etc.)
    22	
    23	CTA Button: "Search"
    24	
    25	## Popular Specialties
    26	A grid of clickable specialty cards that navigate to filtered search results:
    27	
    28	- **Primary Care** — Annual checkups, sick visits, and preventive care
    29	- **Dentist** — Cleanings, fillings, and oral health exams
    30	- **Dermatologist** — Skin conditions, acne, and cosmetic consultations
    31	- **Psychiatrist** — Mental health evaluations and medication management
    32	- **Eye Doctor** — Vision exams, glasses prescriptions, and eye health
    33	- **Orthopedic Surgeon** — Joint pain, fractures, and sports injuries
    34	
    35	Each card includes a specialty icon and label. Clicking a card triggers a filtered search for that specialty.
    36	
    37	## How It Works
    38	A three-step visual guide explaining the MedBook booking flow:
    39	
    40	1. **Search for a provider** — Enter your specialty, condition, or doctor name along with your location and insurance. Browse detailed provider profiles with photos, credentials, and office hours.
    41	2. **Choose a time that works for you** — View real-time availability and pick an appointment slot that fits your schedule — including same-day and next-day options.
    42	3. **Book your appointment instantly** — Confirm your visit in just a few clicks. Receive instant confirmation and reminders so you never miss an appointment.
    43	
    44	## Platform Statistics
    45	Key metrics displayed as a horizontal stats bar or badge row:
    46	
    47	- **4.8M+** verified patient reviews
    48	- **12,000+** healthcare providers nationwide
    49	- **Same-day** appointments available daily
    50	- **100% free** for patients — always
    51	
    52	## Testimonials
    53	- "I found a great dermatologist near my office and booked a same-day appointment during my lunch break. MedBook made it incredibly easy." — **Priya M.**, New York, NY
    54	- "As someone new to the city, MedBook helped me find a primary care doctor who accepts my insurance in under five minutes. Highly recommend!" — **James T.**, Chicago, IL
    55	- "I was dreading finding a new dentist, but the verified reviews on MedBook gave me confidence. My appointment was exactly what I needed." — **Laura K.**, Austin, TX
    56	
    57	## Mobile App Promo
    58	Title: Your health, in your pocket
    59	Subtitle: Download the MedBook app to search for doctors, manage appointments, and get reminders — all on the go. Available on iOS and Android.
    60	CTA: "Download on the App Store" | "Get it on Google Play"
    61	
    62	Key app features:
    63	- Book and manage appointments anywhere
    64	- Get real-time appointment reminders
    65	- Access your visit history and provider details
    66	- Read and leave verified reviews
    67	
    68	## Header Navigation
    69	- Logo: MedBook (links to home)
    70	- Nav links: Browse · Help · Log In · Sign Up
    71	- Mobile: Hamburger menu icon toggles a slide-out drawer with Browse, Log In, and Sign Up
    72	
    73	## Footer Navigation
    74	**For Patients:** Find a Doctor · Browse Specialties · Read Reviews · Insurance Guide
    75	**For Providers:** List Your Practice · Provider Resources · Advertise with Us
    76	**Company:** About MedBook · Careers · Press · Blog · Contact Us
    77	**Legal:** Terms of Service · Privacy Policy · Accessibility · Do Not Sell My Info
    78	
    79	Tagline in footer: © 2024 MedBook, Inc. All rights reserved. MedBook is free for patients. Always.

steps.message:
The MedBook corporate landing page has been built and saved to `/app/output/index.html`. Here's a summary of what was created:

## MedBook Landing Page — Complete

### Sections Implemented
1. **Sticky Header** — Logo, desktop nav (Browse, Help, Log In, Sign Up), and mobile hamburger toggle
2. **Hero Section** — Navy gradient background with animated glow orbs, bold headline, subtitle, and the dominant **3-field search bar** (specialty autocomplete, location, insurance dropdown) with yellow "Search" CTA
3. **Platform Stats** — 4 key metrics (4.8M+ reviews, 12,000+ providers, same-day appointments, 100% free)
4. **Popular Specialties** — 6 clickable cards with Lucide icons (Primary Care, Dentist, Dermatologist, Psychiatrist, Eye Doctor, Orthopedic Surgeon)
5. **How It Works** — 3-step visual guide with numbered circles and connectors
6. **Testimonials** — 3 patient review cards with initials avatars
7. **Mobile App Promo** — Feature list + CSS phone mockup + App Store/Google Play buttons
8. **Footer** — 4-column link grid + logo + copyright

### Interactions & Animations
- **Search autocomplete** — Dropdown suggestions appear on focus/type, selectable with click
- **Insurance dropdown** — Click-to-open selector with 8 carrier options
- **Mobile slide-out menu** — Hamburger toggles a drawer with overlay; closes on link click or overlay tap
- **Scroll-triggered fade-in** — Elements animate in as they enter the viewport
- **Hover micro-interactions** — Cards lift, icons invert color, buttons glow/scale
- **Specialty cards** — Click triggers filtered search alert (simulated navigation)

### Design System
- **Colors:** Brand navy `#1B1464`, accent yellow `#FFD930`, white/gray backgrounds
- **Font:** Inter (Google Fonts)
- **Icons:** Lucide (heart-pulse, stethoscope, smile, brain, eye, bone, etc.)
- **Responsive:** Mobile-first with Tailwind breakpoints; search bar stacks vertically on mobile

### Files in `/app/output/`
- `index.html` — Main entry point (self-contained, no build step)
- `tailwind.js`, `flowbite.min.css`, `flowbite.min.js`, `lucide.min.js` — Local vendor assets
